title: Director asking to let AI PR reviewing tool auto merge PRs
description: A Reddit comment mentions: 'I literally just got off a call where a director asked us to let our AI PR reviewing tool auto merge PRs.' This indicates organizational pressure to remove human bottlenecks in the AI coding lifecycle.

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
description: Optio handles the full lifecycle of AI coding agents, including PR monitoring and squash-merging PRs autonomously. It targets removing the human as a bottleneck from the process.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents
description: A control layer for AI agents offering scanning, testing, monitoring, and compliance. Specifically mentions OpenClaw support and mapping to OWASP Agentic Top 10.

title: Anthropic Claude Code Review Beta
description: Anthropic announced a Code Review beta built into Claude Code for Teams/Enterprise, using agents to analyze code blocks for bugs before pull requests.

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM)
description: Microsoft/GitHub open-source CLI for managing AI agent dependencies across Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Aims to solve agent configuration drift in enterprises.

title: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Orchestration system that uses Claude Code/Codex to go from issue to merged PR in isolated K8s pods. Features 'self-healing' (feeding CI failures back to agent) and 'completion' (squash-merge). Strong overlap with Permission Protocol focus on automated PR flows.

title: Lushbinary: Secure Autonomous Coding Agents Guide
summary: Blog post advocating for policies defining human ownership and requiring human sign-off on all agent changes reaching production. Explicitly mentions the need for documenting agent security policies.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM)
summary: Microsoft/GitHub-led OSS tool to manage agent configurations (skills, rules, MCP servers) with lockfiles and audits. Addresses 'agent supply chain' risks and scans for hidden Unicode in instructions.

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents
summary: Security scanner and runtime monitor for agents. Includes 'g0 daemon' for continuous monitoring with a kill switch. Maps findings to OWASP Agentic Top 10 and EU AI Act. Competitor/Partner signal for agent governance.

title: Ask HN: What is your dev set up like?
summary: User 'break_the_bank' identifies deployment and API key management as the slowest part of agentic workflows. Mentions desire to 'push a job to the web when I am leaving work'—indicating a demand for trusted autonomous deployment.
